_README: FROZEN GROUND-TRUTH LABELING SPEC for the CADETS E3 evaluation. This is the ONLY place attack-vs-benign truth enters the pipeline; the detector/tagger never sees it. Anchored on the DARPA TA5.1 ground-truth report. VERIFY completeness against the report before the official scored run; the code reads this file, so edits here need no code change.
timezone_note: Ground-truth report times are US Eastern (UTC-4), confirmed by the April 6 crash (12:08 EDT) matching the last baseline-file record (16:08:59 UTC) and the April 11 crash likewise. Windows below are in UTC.
ioc_rule: An event is a ground-truth attack IOC iff its timestamp is within an attack window AND (its acting process name is in implant_process_names, OR it is an outbound connection to an IP in c2_ips_corroborating, OR it writes/unlinks a file whose basename starts with an implant_file_basename). Process-name and window come from the report (authority); they are independent of the detector's generic 'server dialed out' rule.
path_label_rule: A candidate path is ATTACK iff it contains >= 2 IOC events (frozen; sensitivity at >=3 reported); BENIGN iff 0 IOC events; EXCLUDED from the main run iff exactly 1.
source: DARPA Transparent Computing E3 CADETS ground-truth report (Kudu Dynamics / TA5.1) and the companion cadets_e3_attack_mapping.csv
